purpose: T1.4 trigger test: does the published pushpress description fire on gym-operations prompts and stay quiet on near misses
frozen: written before the first counting run; no prompt is tuned after a result

prompts.text: Open PushPress and tell me what our cheapest membership plan costs per month.
In PushPress, where do I see which members had a failed payment this week?
Can the PushPress API give me a list of our class types, or do I have to look at the admin pages?
How do I check in PushPress whether a member has signed their waiver?
In the gym software, where do I see check-ins by class for last month?
Log in to the gym software and tell me when our next deposit is due.
One of our gym members' monthly payments failed last night. Where do I see every failed payment and the reason for each?
How many people came to our 6am classes last week? Where would I find attendance by class?
Which of our gym members haven't signed the liability waiver yet, and where would I check?
What does our unlimited membership cost per month? I need the exact number to quote a prospect.
When is our next bank deposit from membership payments, and how do I see what's in it?
Someone filled in the contact form on our gym's website. Where do I read their message and answer it?
How do I add a 10-class pass for a client in Mindbody and set it to expire after three months?
In Wix, how do I add a new page for our summer camp and keep it out of the site menu?
We're pricing our new software product. Should the plans be per-seat or usage-based, and how many tiers make sense?
In our Google Sheets budget workbook, how do I total monthly revenue by category with a QUERY formula?
Write a Node.js Express handler that verifies a Stripe webhook signature and ignores duplicate events.
On the USA Weightlifting Sport80 portal, how do I look up the results of last month's meet?
How do I renew my USA Weightlifting membership on Sport80 before it expires?
In Sport80, how can I see which of our club's members have an expired USAW membership?
In Wodify, how do I set up a drop-in rate for visitors?
What's a sensible monthly price for a small-group strength training membership in a suburban town?
Write a Python function that takes a list of check-in dates and returns a member's longest attendance streak in weeks.
How do I send a monthly newsletter to our gym's mailing list in Mailchimp and avoid the spam folder?
